Ministry of Education, Science, Vocational Training and Early Education / Curriculum Development Centre, Zambia. 'Agricultural Science Syllabus, Grades 10-12' (2013, published by CDC, ISBN 9982-00-548-X) — Grade 12, Topics 12.1-12.9. Genuine gap fill, part of the same real syllabus as this app's new Grade 10 and Grade 11 Agricultural Science files; this app previously had no OBC Grade 10-12 Agricultural Science content at all. Topic, sub-topic and Specific Outcome statements only; Content (Knowledge/Skills/Values) columns omitted, consistent with every other bundled OBC subject in this app.

STRUCTURAL TERM SPLIT (not sourced, same convention as this app's Biology Grade 10-12 files): the 9 real topics are divided into three equal groups of 3 topics each, in original curriculum order (12.1-12.3, 12.4-12.6, 12.7-12.9), labelled 'Term 1'/'Term 2'/'Term 3' purely so the app can generate and share one term at a time. No topic, sub-topic, or competency was added, removed, or altered.

Real irregularities documented, not silently corrected: (1) under Livestock Production, the raw source table prints outcomes labelled '12.6.4.1'/'12.6.4.2' (about nutritional deficiency symptoms and pasture species) directly under the '12.6.2 Health in Livestock' header, before a separate '12.6.3 Livestock Feed' header and then a differently-themed '12.6.4 Pests and Diseases of Livestock' section with its own fresh '12.6.4.1-12.6.4.3' outcomes about pest/disease prevention — an apparent copy-paste numbering carryover from the Grade 10/11 versions of this syllabus, where nutritional deficiencies is its own separate sub-topic. The syllabus's own Appendix I 'Scope and Sequence Chart' lists no separate 'Nutritional Deficiencies' sub-topic for Grade 12 at all, only a single 'Health in livestock' sub-topic — so, cross-checked against that real chart, the nutritional-deficiency outcomes are kept under '12.6.2 Health in Livestock' here, matching the Appendix, and the pest/disease-prevention outcomes are kept under a separate '12.6.4 Pests and Diseases of Livestock' sub-topic, also matching the Appendix. (2) under '12.6.8 Methods of Fish Farming in Zambia', the source table's outcomes jump from '12.6.8.1' straight to '12.6.8.3' — a real gap (an outcome numbered .2 is missing from the extracted text) — left as a real gap, nothing invented to fill it. No individual person's name is cited in this note, consistent with how this app cites every other CDC syllabus.
